form_plan.primary_theme_description: A modal D-dorian theme in open fourths and fifths, hovering between A and D over a slow moving drone bass; the antecedent phrase ends on the bVII (C) and the consequent settles on the tonic D.

sections.description: Lone D drone with rising D-F-A-D bell arpeggio; the melody enters as a distant call.
First statement of the theme over Dm-Bb-F-C; bass sustains, upper voices thin.
Consequent phrase over Gm-Bb-C-Dm resolving on D, closed with a single high bell.
Theme repeat with pulsing root-fifth bass and an inner alto counter-voice.
Consequent repeat, counter-voice answering in contrary motion.
Eerie shift: ostinato bass on Gm-Eb-Bb-F, melody leaning on the flat sixth and the Neapolitan Eb; sparse crystal bell tolls.
Second bridge phrase rising to a raised-leading-tone A major dominant, bells glinting.
Bridge intensifies: low counter-line added beneath the ostinato.
Fullest bridge texture, drawing the harmony back toward D.
Transitional descent through Dm-Am-Bb-A, chromatic C# hinting the return.
Hush: bare drone with sparse bells and a lone descending call.
Full return of the first phrase with shimmering bell arpeggios instead of the counter-line.
Final cadence on D with counter-voice and a closing bell ring.
Drone decays into silence, one last bell lingering.

intent.composition_notes: D dorian modal piece at 90 BPM for POKEY with the 16-bit pure bass pair driving channel 0; channel 1 is left silent as the hardware slave. Only three voices sound: a deep drone bass, a recorder-like lead, and a single flexible third voice that alternates between an alto counter-line and crystal bell arpeggios. Open fifths, the dorian natural sixth, the Neapolitan Eb of the B section and a chromatic C# leading tone supply the eerie medieval-fantasy colour. Deliberate silences (empty third voice in the first statements, channel 3 absent from every sparse pattern) create breathing room between the A and B sections.
